name: content-engine-by-ruby
description: Brand-neutral AI content engine. Research competitors + what is ranking/trending, plan a 30-day calendar, draft long-form blogs, generate LinkedIn/Facebook posts + Canva clickbait images, optimize for Google SEO (E-E-A-T, Helpful Content, indexability, human voice) and run broad SEO audits, then publish. Everything reads from config/brand.json, so the same skills fit any company.
